CREATE TABLE "public"."incident" (
  "bus_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "company_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "detected_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "journey_id" int4,
  "latitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "longitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "resolved_at" timestamptz,
  "route_id" int4,
  "severity" text DEFAULT 'MEDIUM' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "incident_severity_check_5e5a5e80" CHECK ("severity" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL')),
  CONSTRAINT "incident_status_check_ba3a9c90" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'DISPATCHED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'RESOLVED', 'FALSE_ALARM')),
  CONSTRAINT "incident_type_check_c6f17e7c" CHECK ("type" IN ('UNANTICIPATED_STOP', 'ROUTE_DEVIATION', 'ACCIDENT', 'BREAKDOWN', 'KIDNAPPING', 'DRIVER_SOS'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."incidentDispatch" (
  "accepted_at" timestamptz,
  "arrived_at" timestamptz,
  "dispatched_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "incident_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "resolved_at" timestamptz,
  "responder_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "responder_location_id" int4,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "incidentDispatch_status_check_8fd88ccf" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'EN_ROUTE', 'ON_SCENE', 'COMPLETED', 'DECLINED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."journey" (
  "bus_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "company_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "ended_at" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "route_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "session_id" int4,
  "started_at" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "journey_status_check_c6f373de" CHECK ("status" IN ('SCHEDULED', 'ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."responderLocation" (
  "branch_name" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "longitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "responder_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."route" (
  "company_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "polyline" text,
  "route_code" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."routeStop" (
  "route_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "stop_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "stop_order" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("route_id", "stop_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."stop" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "longitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "radius_meters" int4 DEFAULT 100 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
